FAQ

Does Screenshot Clean delete photos automatically?

⌄
No. You review every photo yourself and choose what to delete. Nothing is removed without your confirmation.

Does the app upload my photos anywhere?

⌄
Never. All processing happens locally on your device. No servers, no cloud, no accounts.

What is Copy Text?

⌄
Copy Text uses on-device OCR to extract text from a screenshot — save the info, then delete the image.

How much does Screenshot Clean cost?

⌄
$0.99 one-time purchase. No subscription, no hidden fees, no in-app purchases. Pay once, use forever.

Which iPhones are supported?

⌄
Screenshot Clean requires iOS 16 or later and works on all modern iPhone models.
